config.markdown: The last 7 days, against the 7 days before. All products. Each card is one line: the value, then its change on last week, with an arrow (▲ up, ▼ down) and a dot: 🟢 better, 🔴 worse, ⚪ no change. "No data found within time range." means "no data yet". A line that ends in "no change figure" has no number in the 7 days before to compare with. Higher is better: Value created, Products changed, Decisions (made, evaluated, good process and good outcome). Lower is better: Delivery lead time, Waste, Tokens and turns, Inventory cost, Decisions (due), Cost per value. Decisions has three lines: made and evaluated, the share graded good (its change is in percentage points, pts), and due. Cost per value is the cost of the 7 days in Australian dollars (tokens, human attention and cloud spend) divided by the value of the 7 days. "no value" means a cost and no value in the 7 days. "fixes A$<n> (waste)" is the part of the cost spent on fixes. Delivery lead time has data after the first release that follows spec-release-phase. Inventory cost is in Australian dollars (A$): the tokens at the list prices, plus human attention. "human attention: no data yet" means no answer in the last 7 days, "human attention: no rate set" means answers but no hourly rate, and "tokens: no exchange rate set" means no exchange rate. A note after the change, "not priced: <model>", "old stock not priced" or "past the series limit", is a defect to fix.

SELECT concat(multiIf(toUInt64(round(value)) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(value)), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(value)), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(value)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toUInt64(round(value)) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(value)), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(value)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(toUInt64(round(value)))), ' features and fixes  ', multiIf(value_change_pct IS NULL, 'no change figure', round(value_change_pct) > 0, concat('🟢 ▲ ', toString(toInt64(round(value_change_pct))), '% on last week'), round(value_change_pct) < 0, concat('🔴 ▼ ', toString(abs(toInt64(round(value_change_pct)))), '% on last week'), '⚪ 0% on last week')) AS ` `
FROM (
-- Note: None. The value is the product features used plus the fixes confirmed in the 7 days.
-- Waits for: evidence-follow-up (until it merges, no confirmed file exists, so no fix counts)
-- Value created: the count of spec.id values whose counter <product>.feature.used rose in the 7 days, plus the count of spec.id values of the gauge
-- pod.fix.confirmed_at whose newest time falls in the 7 days. The change is against the 7 days before.
-- Counter rule: the README rule "The counter rule" in docs/references/telemetry/README.md. Each point rises by its value minus the
-- previous point of its series. A first point, or a point below the previous one (Harold restarted), rises by its whole value.
-- After a restart the counter starts again from 0, so only the new uses count. The query reads the points of 21 days: 14 days of two weeks
-- and 7 days before them for the previous point.
-- A fix is a spec.id, not a rise: a restart exports the same confirmed time again, so a fix counts once. The gauge reads the points of 15 days,
-- and takes the largest time of each spec.id.
-- A feature seeded at 0 with no use gives 0. With no feature-use series and no confirmed fix at all there is no row: the tile shows
-- HyperDX's empty state, not 0.
-- value_change_pct is the percent change against the 7 days before. It is empty when the 7 days before have no value.
-- Columns: value, value_change_pct.
WITH
    uses AS (
        SELECT
            uniqExactIf(spec, rise > 0 AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS this_n,
            uniqExactIf(spec, rise > 0 AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS last_n,
            countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY) AS seen
        FROM (
            SELECT
                Attributes['spec.id'] AS spec,
                TimeUnix,
                if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    Attributes,
                    TimeUnix,
                    Value,
                    lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                        PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                        ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before
                FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
                WHERE MetricName LIKE '%.feature.used'
                  AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 21 DAY
            )
        )
    ),
    fixes AS (
        SELECT
            uniqExactIf(spec, confirmed > toUnixTimestamp(now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS this_n,
            uniqExactIf(spec, confirmed > toUnixTimestamp(now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND confirmed <= toUnixTimestamp(now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS last_n,
            count() AS seen
        FROM (
            SELECT
                Attributes['spec.id'] AS spec,
                max(Value) AS confirmed
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
            WHERE MetricName = 'pod.fix.confirmed_at'
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 15 DAY
            GROUP BY spec
        )
    )
SELECT
    toFloat64(uses.this_n + fixes.this_n) AS value,
    round((uses.this_n + fixes.this_n - (uses.last_n + fixes.last_n)) / nullIf(uses.last_n + fixes.last_n, 0) * 100) AS value_change_pct
FROM uses
CROSS JOIN fixes
WHERE uses.seen + fixes.seen > 0
LIMIT 1
)
WHERE value IS NOT NULL

SELECT concat(concat(toString(intDiv(toInt64(round(days * 10)), 10)), '.', toString(toInt64(round(days * 10)) % 10)), ' days  ', multiIf(days_change_pct IS NULL, 'no change figure', round(days_change_pct) > 0, concat('🔴 ▲ ', toString(toInt64(round(days_change_pct))), '% on last week'), round(days_change_pct) < 0, concat('🟢 ▼ ', toString(abs(toInt64(round(days_change_pct)))), '% on last week'), '⚪ 0% on last week')) AS ` `
FROM (
-- Note: The slowest spec of the week is the first one to check when the delivery lead time grows. Read pod.spec.lead_time by spec.id and phase.
-- Waits for: nothing
-- Delivery lead time: the median days from the first draft of a spec to the release that holds it, for the specs released in the 7 days,
-- and the change against the specs released in the 7 days before.
-- The days of a spec are the sum of its four phases: open_to_approved, approved_to_started, started_to_completed and merged_to_released.
-- Each phase of a spec is recorded once, so the value of a phase is the Sum of the first point of its series. The join key is spec.id.
-- The release time of a spec is the time of its first merged_to_released point. A spec without all four phases does not count.
-- The first phases of a spec are recorded before its release, so the query reads all points of the metric, not only the last 14 days.
-- The median of an even number of sums is the mean of the two middle sums.
-- No spec released in the 7 days, or no merged_to_released point at all: no row, not 0. The tile shows HyperDX's empty state.
-- days_change_pct is the percent change against the 7 days before. It is empty when no spec was released in the 7 days before.
-- Columns: days, days_change_pct.
WITH
    phases AS (
        SELECT
            Attributes['spec.id'] AS spec,
            Attributes['phase'] AS phase,
            min(TimeUnix) AS recorded,
            argMin(Sum, TimeUnix) AS seconds
        FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
        WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.lead_time'
          AND Attributes['phase'] IN ('open_to_approved', 'approved_to_started', 'started_to_completed', 'merged_to_released')
        GROUP BY spec, phase
    ),
    released AS (
        SELECT
            spec,
            maxIf(recorded, phase = 'merged_to_released') AS released_at,
            sum(seconds) / 86400 AS spec_days
        FROM phases
        GROUP BY spec
        HAVING count() = 4
    )
SELECT
    this_days AS days,
    round((this_days - last_days) / nullIf(last_days, 0) * 100) AS days_change_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        if(countIf(released_at > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL, quantileExactInclusiveIf(0.5)(spec_days, released_at > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS this_days,
        if(countIf(released_at > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND released_at <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL,
           quantileExactInclusiveIf(0.5)(spec_days, released_at > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND released_at <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS last_days
    FROM released
)
WHERE this_days IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 1
)
WHERE days IS NOT NULL

SELECT concat(multiIf(toUInt64(round(hours)) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(hours)), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(hours)), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(hours)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toUInt64(round(hours)) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(hours)), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(hours)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(toUInt64(round(hours)))), ' hours  ', multiIf(hours_change_pct IS NULL, 'no change figure', round(hours_change_pct) > 0, concat('🔴 ▲ ', toString(toInt64(round(hours_change_pct))), '% on last week'), round(hours_change_pct) < 0, concat('🟢 ▼ ', toString(abs(toInt64(round(hours_change_pct)))), '% on last week'), '⚪ 0% on last week')) AS ` `
FROM (
-- Note: A day with over 2 slot hours of free slots with work waiting needs a look. So does a spec with over 2 redo hours.
-- Waits for: nothing
-- Waste: the hours of the 7 days, rounded to whole hours: the slot hours in which a slot was free while work waited, plus the redo hours.
-- The slot hours read pod.slots.idle_with_work: the sum of the points times 30, divided by 3600.
-- The redo hours read pod.spec.effort at measure redo_hours: the last value of each spec of the week, summed.
-- A spec counts in a week only when it changed or merged in that week. The README states that pod.spec.effort sends a value on every poll for each spec
-- that is not completed or withdrawn, and for each spec that entered one of those states in the last 30 days. So the points of a spec repeat
-- until the spec changes. A spec changed in a week when its state, its `revisions` value or its `build_worker_hours` value at the end of the week
-- differs from the value at the end of the week before, or when it has no point before the week. A spec that merged in the week changed its state.
-- A source with no point in the 7 days gives no hours. With no source at all there is no row: the tile shows HyperDX's empty state, not 0.
-- hours_change_pct is the percent change against the 7 days before. It is empty when the 7 days before have no hours.
-- Columns: hours, hours_change_pct.
WITH
    touched AS (
        SELECT
            spec,
            max(this_changed) AS this_changed,
            max(last_changed) AS last_changed
        FROM (
            SELECT
                Attributes['spec.id'] AS spec,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS v2,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Attributes['state'], TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS s2,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS v1,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Attributes['state'], TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS s1,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY) AS v0,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Attributes['state'], TimeUnix, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY) AS s0,
                isNotNull(v2) AND (isNull(v1) AND isNull(v0) OR ifNull(v2 != if(isNull(v1), v0, v1) OR s2 != if(isNull(s1), s0, s1), 1)) AS this_changed,
                isNotNull(v1) AND (isNull(v0) OR ifNull(v1 != v0 OR s1 != s0, 1)) AS last_changed
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
            WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.effort'
              AND Attributes['measure'] IN ('revisions', 'build_worker_hours')
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY
            GROUP BY Attributes['spec.id'], Attributes['measure']
        )
        GROUP BY spec
    ),
    (SELECT groupArray(spec) FROM touched WHERE this_changed) AS this_specs,
    (SELECT groupArray(spec) FROM touched WHERE last_changed) AS last_specs,
    slots AS (
        SELECT
            countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS this_n,
            sumIf(Value, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) * 30 / 3600 AS this_hours,
            countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS last_n,
            sumIf(Value, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) * 30 / 3600 AS last_hours
        FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
        WHERE MetricName = 'pod.slots.idle_with_work'
          AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
    ),
    redo AS (
        SELECT
            count(this_v) AS this_n,
            sum(this_v) AS this_hours,
            count(last_v) AS last_n,
            sum(last_v) AS last_hours
        FROM (
            SELECT
                argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND has(this_specs, Attributes['spec.id'])) AS this_v,
                argMaxIfOrNull(Value, TimeUnix, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND has(last_specs, Attributes['spec.id'])) AS last_v
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
            WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.effort'
              AND Attributes['measure'] = 'redo_hours'
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
            GROUP BY Attributes['spec.id']
        )
    )
SELECT
    round(this_total) AS hours,
    round((this_total - last_total) / nullIf(last_total, 0) * 100) AS hours_change_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        if(slots.this_n = 0 AND redo.this_n = 0, NULL, ifNull(slots.this_hours, 0) + ifNull(redo.this_hours, 0)) AS this_total,
        if(slots.last_n = 0 AND redo.last_n = 0, NULL, ifNull(slots.last_hours, 0) + ifNull(redo.last_hours, 0)) AS last_total
    FROM slots
    CROSS JOIN redo
)
WHERE this_total IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 1
)
WHERE hours IS NOT NULL

SELECT concat(concat(toString(intDiv(toInt64(round(tokens_m * 10)), 10)), '.', toString(toInt64(round(tokens_m * 10)) % 10)), ' M tokens  ', multiIf(tokens_m_change_pct IS NULL, 'no change figure', round(tokens_m_change_pct) > 0, concat('🔴 ▲ ', toString(toInt64(round(tokens_m_change_pct))), '% on last week'), round(tokens_m_change_pct) < 0, concat('🟢 ▼ ', toString(abs(toInt64(round(tokens_m_change_pct)))), '% on last week'), '⚪ 0% on last week'), if(turns IS NULL, '', concat(' · ', multiIf(toUInt64(round(turns)) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(turns)), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(turns)), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(turns)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toUInt64(round(turns)) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(turns)), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(turns)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(toUInt64(round(turns)))), ' turns'))) AS ` `
FROM (
-- Note: A build worker on an Opus model is the first thing to check, because build workers belong on Sonnet. The tokens of subagents are not counted.
-- Waits for: nothing
-- Tokens and turns is the flow: all tokens spent in the 7 days, on all work. Inventory cost is the stock.
-- The tokens are the rise of the counter harold.turn.tokens (all four kinds, models other than none: the seeded start points are left out), in M with one decimal.
-- The turns are the rise of the counter harold.turns.
-- Counter rule: the README rule "The counter rule" in docs/references/telemetry/README.md. Each point rises by its value minus the
-- previous point of its series. A first point, or a point below the previous one (Harold restarted), rises by its whole value.
-- The query reads the points of 21 days: 14 days of two weeks and 7 days before them for the previous point.
-- A source with no point in the 7 days gives no number (the column is NULL, and its tile shows HyperDX's empty state). It never gives 0.
-- A change column is empty when the 7 days before have no number.
-- overflow is 1 when harold.turn.tokens.by_spec has its overflow series (otel.metric.overflow = true) with a point in the 7 days, and 0 otherwise.
-- With an overflow series the per spec tokens are a lower bound.
-- Columns: tokens_m, tokens_m_change_pct, turns, turns_change_pct, overflow.
SELECT
    if(tokens_n = 0, NULL, round(tokens_now / 1000000, 1)) AS tokens_m,
    round((tokens_now - tokens_before) / nullIf(tokens_before, 0) * 100) AS tokens_m_change_pct,
    if(turns_n = 0, NULL, round(turns_now)) AS turns,
    round((turns_now - turns_before) / nullIf(turns_before, 0) * 100) AS turns_change_pct,
    toUInt8(overflow_n > 0) AS overflow
FROM (
    SELECT
        sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.turn.tokens' AND Attributes['model'] != 'none' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS tokens_now,
        sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.turn.tokens' AND Attributes['model'] != 'none' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS tokens_before,
        countIf(MetricName = 'harold.turn.tokens' AND Attributes['model'] != 'none' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS tokens_n,
        sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.turns' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS turns_now,
        sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.turns' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS turns_before,
        countIf(MetricName = 'harold.turns' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS turns_n,
        countIf(MetricName = 'harold.turn.tokens.by_spec' AND Attributes['otel.metric.overflow'] = 'true' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS overflow_n
    FROM (
        SELECT
            MetricName,
            Attributes,
            TimeUnix,
            if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise
        FROM (
            SELECT
                MetricName,
                Attributes,
                TimeUnix,
                Value,
                lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                    ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
            WHERE MetricName IN ('harold.turn.tokens', 'harold.turns', 'harold.turn.tokens.by_spec')
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 21 DAY
        )
    )
)
WHERE tokens_n > 0 OR turns_n > 0
LIMIT 1
)
WHERE tokens_m IS NOT NULL

SELECT concat(multiIf(toUInt64(round(products)) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(products)), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(products)), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(products)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toUInt64(round(products)) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(products)), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(products)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(toUInt64(round(products)))), ' products  ', multiIf(products_change_pct IS NULL, 'no change figure', round(products_change_pct) > 0, concat('🟢 ▲ ', toString(toInt64(round(products_change_pct))), '% on last week'), round(products_change_pct) < 0, concat('🔴 ▼ ', toString(abs(toInt64(round(products_change_pct)))), '% on last week'), '⚪ 0% on last week')) AS ` `
FROM (
-- Note: None. The value is the number of products with at least one merge in the 7 days.
-- Waits for: nothing
-- Products changed: the products whose merged specs rose in the counter pod.merges. A series is one spec.id, so a new spec.id rises by its whole value.
-- Counter rule: the README rule "The counter rule" in docs/references/telemetry/README.md. Each point rises by its value minus the
-- previous point of its series. A first point, or a point below the previous one (Harold restarted), rises by its whole value.
-- The query reads the points of 21 days: 14 days of two weeks and 7 days before them for the previous point.
-- No row while no product has a merge in the 7 days: the tile shows HyperDX's empty state, not 0.
-- products_change_pct is the percent change against the 7 days before. It is empty when no product had a merge in the 7 days before.
-- Columns: products, products_change_pct.
SELECT
    this_products AS products,
    round((this_products - last_products) / nullIf(last_products, 0) * 100) AS products_change_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        uniqExactIf(Attributes['pod.product'], rise > 0 AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS this_products,
        uniqExactIf(Attributes['pod.product'], rise > 0 AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS last_products
    FROM (
        SELECT
            MetricName,
            Attributes,
            TimeUnix,
            if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise
        FROM (
            SELECT
                MetricName,
                Attributes,
                TimeUnix,
                Value,
                lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                    ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
            WHERE MetricName = 'pod.merges'
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 21 DAY
        )
    )
)
WHERE this_products > 0
LIMIT 1
)
WHERE products IS NOT NULL

SELECT concat(concat('A$', multiIf(toUInt64(round(total_cost)) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(total_cost)), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(total_cost)), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(total_cost)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toUInt64(round(total_cost)) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(total_cost)), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(total_cost)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(toUInt64(round(total_cost)))), '  (', multiIf(token_cost IS NOT NULL, concat('tokens A$', multiIf(toUInt64(round(token_cost)) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(token_cost)), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(token_cost)), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(token_cost)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toUInt64(round(token_cost)) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(token_cost)), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(token_cost)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(toUInt64(round(token_cost))))), tokens_m IS NOT NULL, 'tokens: no exchange rate set', 'tokens A$0'), ' + ', multiIf(attention_hours IS NULL, 'human attention: no data yet', attention_cost IS NULL, 'human attention: no rate set', concat('human attention A$', multiIf(toUInt64(round(attention_cost)) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(attention_cost)), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(attention_cost)), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(attention_cost)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toUInt64(round(attention_cost)) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(attention_cost)), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(attention_cost)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(toUInt64(round(attention_cost)))))), ')  '), multiIf(total_cost_change_pct IS NULL, 'no change figure', round(total_cost_change_pct) > 0, concat('🔴 ▲ ', toString(toInt64(round(total_cost_change_pct))), '% on last week'), round(total_cost_change_pct) < 0, concat('🟢 ▼ ', toString(abs(toInt64(round(total_cost_change_pct)))), '% on last week'), '⚪ 0% on last week'), concat(arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(m -> concat(' · not priced: ', m), arrayFilter(m -> m != '', splitByChar(',', ifNull(unpriced_models, '')))), ''), if(ifNull(old_stock_unpriced, 0) = 1, ' · old stock not priced', ''), if(ifNull(overflow, 0) = 1, ' · past the series limit', ''))) AS ` `
FROM (
-- Note: The stock is the tokens already spent on specs that have not reached you, at any time. Tokens and turns is the flow of the 7 days.
-- Waits for: the release that brings the gauges harold.list_price.per_mtok and harold.exchange_rate.usd_to_aud (the notes show until then).
-- Inventory cost, the stock: the tokens spent so far (harold.turn.tokens.by_spec, the four kinds) on the specs that are approved or in progress now,
-- in M with one decimal (tokens_m), and their cost in AUD (token_cost). The spec.id of a series joins the newest state of the spec in pod.spec.words (the points of the last 37 days).
-- The change compares the stock now with the stock 7 days ago: the tokens spent up to then on the specs that were approved or in progress then.
-- Token cost: each series (spec, model, kind) is priced at its list price, USD per million tokens, read with dictGetOrNull from the ClickHouse dictionary
-- otel.harold_settings (row name harold.list_price.per_mtok/<model>/<kind>). The sum in USD is multiplied by the exchange rate (row harold.exchange_rate.usd_to_aud).
-- The dictionary holds only the newest list price and exchange rate. A change of either prices the whole stock again, the stock 7 days ago too.
-- Old stock: a series recorded before the model was added has model '' and its input holds all three input kinds. It is priced at the mix of the build workers of the
-- 7 days: the average list price of their input side (input, cache_read, cache_write) and of their output (harold.turn.tokens, role build_worker). A model of the mix with no list price
-- leaves the mix. With no build-worker turn in the 7 days the mix is empty: the old stock adds nothing and old_stock_unpriced is 1.
-- unpriced_models is the models with stock and no list price (one text, names with a comma between them, empty when none). They add nothing.
-- Counter rule: the README rule "The counter rule" in docs/references/telemetry/README.md. Each point rises by its value minus the
-- previous point of its series. A first point, or a point below the previous one (Harold restarted), rises by its whole value.
-- The query reads the points of 60 days of the counter. The overflow series has no spec.id and does not join.
-- overflow is 1 when harold.turn.tokens.by_spec has its overflow series (otel.metric.overflow = true) with a point in the 7 days, and 0 otherwise.
-- Inventory cost, your human attention: the answer hours (the sum of agent.attr.seconds of the chief.attention_answered lines, divided by 3600),
-- the cost (the hours times the rate of the ClickHouse dictionary otel.harold_settings, read with dictGetOrNull), the count of chief.attention_request
-- lines and their median agent.attr.words. The chief records the events (the README section "The attention part's producer"). The attention columns are NULL until the first recorded answer.
-- With no rate in the dictionary, attention_cost and currency are NULL: the card says "human attention: no rate set". The column keeps the name attention_cost.
-- With no exchange rate in the dictionary, token_cost is NULL: the card says "tokens: no exchange rate set".
-- total_cost is token_cost plus attention_cost (the part that is not NULL), in AUD. total_cost_change_pct compares it with the same total 7 days before.
-- A column with no number is NULL, and its tile shows HyperDX's empty state. It is never 0. A change column is empty when the 7 days before have no number.
-- Columns: tokens_m, tokens_m_change_pct, token_cost, attention_hours, attention_cost, attention_cost_change_pct, currency, attention_requests, words_per_request,
-- total_cost, total_cost_change_pct, unpriced_models, old_stock_unpriced, overflow.
WITH
    dictGetOrNull('otel.harold_settings', 'value', tuple('harold.attention.hourly_rate')) AS rate,
    dictGetOrNull('otel.harold_settings', 'currency', tuple('harold.attention.hourly_rate')) AS rate_currency,
    dictGetOrNull('otel.harold_settings', 'value', tuple('harold.exchange_rate.usd_to_aud')) AS usd_to_aud,
    states AS (
        SELECT
            Attributes['spec.id'] AS spec,
            argMax(Attributes['state'], TimeUnix) AS state_now,
            argMaxIf(Attributes['state'], TimeUnix, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS state_before,
            countIf(TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS points_before
        FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
        WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.words'
          AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 37 DAY
        GROUP BY spec
    ),
    series AS (
        SELECT
            Attributes['spec.id'] AS spec,
            Attributes['model'] AS model,
            Attributes['kind'] AS kind,
            sum(rise) AS spent_now,
            sumIf(rise, TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS spent_before
        FROM (
            SELECT
                Attributes,
                TimeUnix,
                if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    Attributes,
                    TimeUnix,
                    Value,
                    lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                        PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                        ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before
                FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
                WHERE MetricName = 'harold.turn.tokens.by_spec'
                  AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 60 DAY
            )
        )
        WHERE spec != ''
        GROUP BY spec, model, kind
    ),
    spent AS (
        SELECT spec, sum(spent_now) AS spent_now, sum(spent_before) AS spent_before
        FROM series
        GROUP BY spec
    ),
    build_turns AS (
        SELECT
            Attributes['model'] AS model,
            Attributes['kind'] AS kind,
            sum(rise) AS tokens
        FROM (
            SELECT
                Attributes,
                TimeUnix,
                if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    Attributes,
                    TimeUnix,
                    Value,
                    lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                        PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                        ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before
                FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
                WHERE MetricName = 'harold.turn.tokens'
                  AND Attributes['role'] = 'build_worker'
                  AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
            )
            WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
        )
        GROUP BY model, kind
    ),
    mix AS (
        SELECT
            sumIf(tokens * price, kind != 'output' AND price IS NOT NULL) / nullIf(sumIf(tokens, kind != 'output' AND price IS NOT NULL), 0) AS input_price,
            sumIf(tokens * price, kind = 'output' AND price IS NOT NULL) / nullIf(sumIf(tokens, kind = 'output' AND price IS NOT NULL), 0) AS output_price
        FROM (
            SELECT
                kind,
                tokens,
                dictGetOrNull('otel.harold_settings', 'value', tuple(concat('harold.list_price.per_mtok/', model, '/', kind))) AS price
            FROM build_turns
        )
    ),
    priced AS (
        SELECT
            spec,
            model,
            kind,
            spent_now,
            spent_before,
            if(model = '',
               if(kind = 'output', output_price, input_price),
               dictGetOrNull('otel.harold_settings', 'value', tuple(concat('harold.list_price.per_mtok/', model, '/', kind)))) AS price
        FROM series
        CROSS JOIN mix
    ),
    stock AS (
        SELECT
            countIf(state_now IN ('approved', 'in_progress')) AS now_n,
            sumIf(spent_now, state_now IN ('approved', 'in_progress')) AS now_tokens,
            countIf(points_before > 0 AND state_before IN ('approved', 'in_progress')) AS before_n,
            sumIf(spent_before, points_before > 0 AND state_before IN ('approved', 'in_progress')) AS before_tokens
        FROM states
        INNER JOIN spent USING (spec)
    ),
    cost AS (
        SELECT
            sumIf(spent_now * price / 1000000, state_now IN ('approved', 'in_progress') AND price IS NOT NULL) AS usd_now,
            sumIf(spent_before * price / 1000000, points_before > 0 AND state_before IN ('approved', 'in_progress') AND price IS NOT NULL) AS usd_before,
            arrayStringConcat(arraySort(groupUniqArrayIf(model,
                model != '' AND price IS NULL AND (
                    (state_now IN ('approved', 'in_progress') AND spent_now > 0)
                    OR (points_before > 0 AND state_before IN ('approved', 'in_progress') AND spent_before > 0)))), ',') AS unpriced,
            toUInt8(countIf(model = '' AND price IS NULL AND (
                    (state_now IN ('approved', 'in_progress') AND spent_now > 0)
                    OR (points_before > 0 AND state_before IN ('approved', 'in_progress') AND spent_before > 0))) > 0) AS old_unpriced
        FROM states
        INNER JOIN priced USING (spec)
    ),
    overflow AS (
        SELECT count() AS overflow_n
        FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
        WHERE MetricName = 'harold.turn.tokens.by_spec'
          AND Attributes['otel.metric.overflow'] = 'true'
          AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    ),
    attention AS (
        SELECT
            countIf(LogAttributes['agent.name'] = 'chief.attention_answered' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS answers_now,
            sumIf(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['agent.attr.seconds']), LogAttributes['agent.name'] = 'chief.attention_answered' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) / 3600 AS hours_now,
            countIf(LogAttributes['agent.name'] = 'chief.attention_answered' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND Timestamp <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS answers_before,
            sumIf(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['agent.attr.seconds']), LogAttributes['agent.name'] = 'chief.attention_answered' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND Timestamp <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) / 3600 AS hours_before,
            countIf(LogAttributes['agent.name'] = 'chief.attention_request' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS requests_now,
            quantileIf(0.5)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['agent.attr.words']), LogAttributes['agent.name'] = 'chief.attention_request' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS words_now
        FROM otel.otel_logs
        WHERE Body = 'agent event'
          AND LogAttributes['agent.name'] IN ('chief.attention_answered', 'chief.attention_request')
          AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
    ),
    totals AS (
        SELECT
            if(now_n = 0 OR usd_to_aud IS NULL, NULL, usd_now * usd_to_aud) AS token_now,
            if(before_n = 0 OR usd_to_aud IS NULL, NULL, usd_before * usd_to_aud) AS token_before,
            if(answers_now = 0 OR rate IS NULL, NULL, round(hours_now * rate)) AS human_now,
            if(answers_before = 0 OR rate IS NULL, NULL, round(hours_before * rate)) AS human_before
        FROM stock
        CROSS JOIN cost
        CROSS JOIN attention
    )
SELECT
    if(now_n = 0, NULL, round(now_tokens / 1000000, 1)) AS tokens_m,
    if(now_n = 0 OR before_n = 0, NULL, round((now_tokens - before_tokens) / nullIf(before_tokens, 0) * 100)) AS tokens_m_change_pct,
    if(token_now IS NULL, NULL, round(token_now, 2)) AS token_cost,
    if(answers_now = 0, NULL, round(hours_now, 1)) AS attention_hours,
    if(answers_now = 0 OR rate IS NULL, NULL, round(hours_now * rate)) AS attention_cost,
    if(answers_now = 0 OR answers_before = 0 OR rate IS NULL, NULL, round((hours_now - hours_before) / nullIf(hours_before, 0) * 100)) AS attention_cost_change_pct,
    if(answers_now = 0 OR rate IS NULL, NULL, rate_currency) AS currency,
    if(requests_now = 0, NULL, requests_now) AS attention_requests,
    if(requests_now = 0, NULL, round(words_now)) AS words_per_request,
    if(token_now IS NULL AND human_now IS NULL, NULL, round(ifNull(token_now, 0) + ifNull(human_now, 0), 2)) AS total_cost,
    if((token_now IS NULL AND human_now IS NULL) OR (token_before IS NULL AND human_before IS NULL)
           OR ifNull(token_before, 0) + ifNull(human_before, 0) = 0, NULL,
       round((ifNull(token_now, 0) + ifNull(human_now, 0) - ifNull(token_before, 0) - ifNull(human_before, 0))
             / (ifNull(token_before, 0) + ifNull(human_before, 0)) * 100)) AS total_cost_change_pct,
    unpriced AS unpriced_models,
    old_unpriced AS old_stock_unpriced,
    toUInt8(overflow_n > 0) AS overflow
FROM stock
CROSS JOIN cost
CROSS JOIN overflow
CROSS JOIN attention
CROSS JOIN totals
WHERE tokens_m IS NOT NULL OR attention_hours IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 1
)
WHERE total_cost IS NOT NULL

SELECT concat(if(cost_per_value IS NULL, concat('no value  (cost A$', multiIf(toUInt64(round(total_cost)) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(total_cost)), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(total_cost)), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(total_cost)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toUInt64(round(total_cost)) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(total_cost)), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(total_cost)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(toUInt64(round(total_cost)))), ')'), concat('A$', multiIf(toUInt64(round(cost_per_value)) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(cost_per_value)), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(cost_per_value)), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(cost_per_value)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toUInt64(round(cost_per_value)) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(cost_per_value)), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(cost_per_value)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(toUInt64(round(cost_per_value)))), ' per value  (A$', multiIf(toUInt64(round(total_cost)) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(total_cost)), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(total_cost)), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(total_cost)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toUInt64(round(total_cost)) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(total_cost)), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(total_cost)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(toUInt64(round(total_cost)))), ' / ', multiIf(toUInt64(round(value)) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(value)), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(value)), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(value)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toUInt64(round(value)) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(value)), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(value)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(toUInt64(round(value)))), ' value)  ', multiIf(cost_per_value_change_pct IS NULL, 'no change figure', round(cost_per_value_change_pct) > 0, concat('🔴 ▲ ', toString(toInt64(round(cost_per_value_change_pct))), '% on last week'), round(cost_per_value_change_pct) < 0, concat('🟢 ▼ ', toString(abs(toInt64(round(cost_per_value_change_pct)))), '% on last week'), '⚪ 0% on last week'))), if(ifNull(fix_cost, 0) > 0, concat(' · fixes A$', multiIf(toUInt64(round(fix_cost)) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(fix_cost)), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(fix_cost)), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(fix_cost)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toUInt64(round(fix_cost)) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(toUInt64(round(fix_cost)), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(toUInt64(round(fix_cost)) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(toUInt64(round(fix_cost)))), ' (waste)'), ''), arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(m -> concat(' · not priced: ', m), arrayFilter(m -> m != '', splitByChar(',', ifNull(unpriced_models, '')))), '')) AS ` `
FROM (
-- Note: Cost per value is the money of the 7 days divided by the value of the 7 days. Down is better. A used feature with no kept value counts 1 and shows in unvalued.
-- Waits for: the release that brings the gauge pod.spec.value (until then no spec has a value, and a used feature counts 1).
-- Cost per value: total_cost (AUD) divided by value. Total cost is the token cost, plus the attention cost, plus the cloud cost. Build hours are not in the cost.
-- Value, two parts added together:
--   Features in use: the specs whose counter <product>.feature.used rose in the 7 days (the rule of value-created.sql), each with its weight, the newest point of
--   pod.spec.value (S = 1, M = 2, L = 4), joined on the product of the metric name and spec.id. A feature with no kept value counts 1 and is counted in unvalued.
--   Other specs merged: the specs with a pod.spec.lead_time point of phase = started_to_completed in the 7 days (the merge, recorded once for each spec) whose
--   newest pod.spec.effort point has spec.kind = other, each with its weight. An other spec with no kept value adds nothing.
--   A feature spec counts only by its use, never by its merge. The fixes of pod.fix.confirmed_at add no value.
-- Token cost: the rise of harold.turn.tokens for every role and model other than none (the rule of inventory-cost.sql and tokens-and-turns.sql), priced with the
-- list price (the ClickHouse dictionary harold_settings, read as a table, row harold.list_price.per_mtok/<model>/<kind>, USD per million tokens), then multiplied
-- by the exchange rate (row harold.exchange_rate.usd_to_aud). A price of 0 counts as no price. Without an exchange rate the token cost, the cloud cost and the fix cost are NULL.
-- unpriced_models is the models with tokens in the 7 days and no list price (one text, names with a comma between them, empty when none). They add nothing.
-- Cloud cost: the only cloud spend that Harold has a metric for is the rise of watch.cost_usd (the hosted model runs of the watches, which are not in
-- harold.turn.tokens), times the exchange rate. Harold has no metric for other cloud spend: the other hosted model runs log their cost but send no metric,
-- and Harold does not see bucket or machine bills.
-- Attention cost: the hours of the chief.attention_answered lines (the sum of agent.attr.seconds, divided by 3600) times harold.attention.hourly_rate (100 today).
-- Fix cost: the token cost of harold.turn.tokens.by_spec for the specs whose newest pod.spec.effort point has spec.kind = fix, in AUD. It is part of total_cost.
-- Fix cost and the Waste card are separate. The Waste card (waste.sql) counts hours. Fix cost is AUD and the two are never added together.
-- cost_per_value is NULL when value is 0. cost_per_value_change_pct compares it with the 7 days before and is NULL when either week has no value or no cost.
-- A cost with no spend in its week is NULL, not 0. A column with no number is NULL. The query has no row when the 7 days have neither a cost nor a value.
-- Read windows: the counters (the sums and the histogram) read 21 days: 14 days of two weeks and 7 days before them for the previous point. The gauges read
-- 15 days. The lines read 14 days.
-- Only the newest list prices and exchange rate are kept, so a change of a rate also prices the week before again.
-- Counter rule: the README rule "The counter rule" in docs/references/telemetry/README.md. Each point rises by its value minus the previous point of its series.
-- A first point, or a point below the previous one (Harold restarted), rises by its whole value.
-- Columns: cost_per_value, cost_per_value_change_pct, value, total_cost, token_cost, attention_cost, cloud_cost, fix_cost, unpriced_models, unvalued.
WITH
    (SELECT anyOrNull(value) FROM otel.harold_settings WHERE name = 'harold.attention.hourly_rate') AS rate,
    (SELECT anyOrNull(value) FROM otel.harold_settings WHERE name = 'harold.exchange_rate.usd_to_aud') AS usd_to_aud,
    prices AS (
        SELECT name, value AS price
        FROM otel.harold_settings
        WHERE name LIKE 'harold.list_price.per_mtok/%'
    ),
    rises AS (
        SELECT
            MetricName,
            Attributes,
            TimeUnix,
            if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise
        FROM (
            SELECT
                MetricName,
                Attributes,
                TimeUnix,
                Value,
                lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                    ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
            WHERE (MetricName IN ('harold.turn.tokens', 'harold.turn.tokens.by_spec', 'watch.cost_usd')
                   OR MetricName LIKE '%.feature.used')
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 21 DAY
        )
    ),
    token_series AS (
        SELECT
            Attributes['model'] AS model,
            Attributes['kind'] AS kind,
            sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS spent_now,
            sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS spent_before
        FROM rises
        WHERE MetricName = 'harold.turn.tokens' AND Attributes['model'] != 'none'
        GROUP BY model, kind
    ),
    tokens AS (
        SELECT
            if(usd_to_aud IS NULL OR countIf(spent_now > 0) = 0, NULL, sumIf(spent_now * price / 1000000, price > 0) * usd_to_aud) AS cost_now,
            if(usd_to_aud IS NULL OR countIf(spent_before > 0) = 0, NULL, sumIf(spent_before * price / 1000000, price > 0) * usd_to_aud) AS cost_before,
            arrayStringConcat(arraySort(groupUniqArrayIf(model, model != '' AND price = 0 AND spent_now > 0)), ',') AS unpriced
        FROM (
            SELECT model, spent_now, spent_before, concat('harold.list_price.per_mtok/', model, '/', kind) AS name
            FROM token_series
        ) AS series
        LEFT JOIN prices USING (name)
    ),
    fix_specs AS (
        SELECT Attributes['spec.id'] AS spec
        FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
        WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.effort'
          AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 15 DAY
        GROUP BY spec
        HAVING argMax(Attributes['spec.kind'], TimeUnix) = 'fix'
    ),
    fixes AS (
        SELECT
            if(usd_to_aud IS NULL OR countIf(spent_now > 0) = 0, NULL, sumIf(spent_now * price / 1000000, price > 0) * usd_to_aud) AS cost_now,
            if(usd_to_aud IS NULL OR countIf(spent_before > 0) = 0, NULL, sumIf(spent_before * price / 1000000, price > 0) * usd_to_aud) AS cost_before
        FROM (
            SELECT
                sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS spent_now,
                sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS spent_before,
                concat('harold.list_price.per_mtok/', Attributes['model'], '/', Attributes['kind']) AS name
            FROM rises
            WHERE MetricName = 'harold.turn.tokens.by_spec'
              AND Attributes['spec.id'] IN (SELECT spec FROM fix_specs)
            GROUP BY name
        ) AS series
        LEFT JOIN prices USING (name)
    ),
    clouds AS (
        SELECT
            if(usd_to_aud IS NULL OR countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL,
               sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) * usd_to_aud) AS cost_now,
            if(usd_to_aud IS NULL OR countIf(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0, NULL,
               sumIf(rise, TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) * usd_to_aud) AS cost_before
        FROM rises
        WHERE MetricName = 'watch.cost_usd'
    ),
    attention AS (
        SELECT
            countIf(Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS answers_now,
            sumIf(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['agent.attr.seconds']), Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) / 3600 AS hours_now,
            countIf(Timestamp <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS answers_before,
            sumIf(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['agent.attr.seconds']), Timestamp <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) / 3600 AS hours_before
        FROM otel.otel_logs
        WHERE Body = 'agent event'
          AND LogAttributes['agent.name'] = 'chief.attention_answered'
          AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
    ),
    weights AS (
        SELECT
            Attributes['pod.product'] AS product,
            Attributes['spec.id'] AS spec,
            argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS weight
        FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
        WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.value'
          AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 15 DAY
        GROUP BY product, spec
    ),
    spec_kinds AS (
        SELECT Attributes['spec.id'] AS spec, argMax(Attributes['spec.kind'], TimeUnix) AS kind
        FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
        WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.effort'
          AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 15 DAY
        GROUP BY spec
    ),
    used AS (
        SELECT
            replaceRegexpOne(MetricName, '\\.feature\\.used$', '') AS product,
            Attributes['spec.id'] AS spec,
            countIf(rise > 0 AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) > 0 AS used_now,
            countIf(rise > 0 AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) > 0 AS used_before
        FROM rises
        WHERE MetricName LIKE '%.feature.used'
        GROUP BY product, spec
    ),
    merged AS (
        SELECT
            Attributes['pod.product'] AS product,
            Attributes['spec.id'] AS spec,
            countIf(rise > 0 AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) > 0 AS merged_now,
            countIf(rise > 0 AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) > 0 AS merged_before
        FROM (
            SELECT
                Attributes,
                TimeUnix,
                if(Count >= before, toInt64(Count) - toInt64(before), toInt64(Count)) AS rise
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    Attributes,
                    TimeUnix,
                    Count,
                    lagInFrame(Count, 1, toUInt64(0)) OVER (
                        PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                        ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before
                FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
                WHERE MetricName = 'pod.spec.lead_time'
                  AND Attributes['phase'] = 'started_to_completed'
                  AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 21 DAY
            )
        )
        GROUP BY product, spec
    ),
    feature_value AS (
        SELECT
            sumIf(if(weight = 0, 1, weight), used_now) AS value_now,
            sumIf(if(weight = 0, 1, weight), used_before) AS value_before,
            countIf(used_now AND weight = 0) AS unvalued_now,
            countIf(used_now OR used_before) AS seen
        FROM used
        LEFT JOIN weights USING (product, spec)
    ),
    other_value AS (
        SELECT
            sumIf(weight, merged_now) AS value_now,
            sumIf(weight, merged_before) AS value_before,
            countIf(merged_now OR merged_before) AS seen
        FROM merged
        INNER JOIN weights USING (product, spec)
        INNER JOIN spec_kinds USING (spec)
        WHERE kind = 'other'
    ),
    totals AS (
        SELECT
            feature_value.value_now + other_value.value_now AS value_now,
            feature_value.value_before + other_value.value_before AS value_before,
            feature_value.unvalued_now AS unvalued,
            tokens.cost_now AS token_now,
            tokens.cost_before AS token_before,
            tokens.unpriced AS unpriced,
            clouds.cost_now AS cloud_now,
            clouds.cost_before AS cloud_before,
            fixes.cost_now AS fix_now,
            if(answers_now = 0 OR rate IS NULL, NULL, hours_now * rate) AS human_now,
            if(answers_before = 0 OR rate IS NULL, NULL, hours_before * rate) AS human_before,
            if(token_now IS NULL AND cloud_now IS NULL AND human_now IS NULL, NULL,
               ifNull(token_now, 0) + ifNull(cloud_now, 0) + ifNull(human_now, 0)) AS total_now,
            if(token_before IS NULL AND cloud_before IS NULL AND human_before IS NULL, NULL,
               ifNull(token_before, 0) + ifNull(cloud_before, 0) + ifNull(human_before, 0)) AS total_before
        FROM feature_value
        CROSS JOIN other_value
        CROSS JOIN tokens
        CROSS JOIN clouds
        CROSS JOIN fixes
        CROSS JOIN attention
    )
SELECT
    if(value_now = 0 OR total_now IS NULL, NULL, round(total_now / value_now, 2)) AS cost_per_value,
    round((total_now / nullIf(value_now, 0) - total_before / nullIf(value_before, 0))
          / nullIf(total_before / nullIf(value_before, 0), 0) * 100) AS cost_per_value_change_pct,
    toFloat64(value_now) AS value,
    if(total_now IS NULL, NULL, round(total_now, 2)) AS total_cost,
    if(token_now IS NULL, NULL, round(token_now, 2)) AS token_cost,
    if(human_now IS NULL, NULL, round(human_now, 2)) AS attention_cost,
    if(cloud_now IS NULL, NULL, round(cloud_now, 2)) AS cloud_cost,
    if(fix_now IS NULL, NULL, round(fix_now, 2)) AS fix_cost,
    unpriced AS unpriced_models,
    unvalued
FROM totals
WHERE total_now IS NOT NULL OR value_now > 0
LIMIT 1
)
WHERE total_cost IS NOT NULL

-- Note: None. The card shows 0 made when no decision record was added in the 7 days.
-- Waits for: nothing
-- Decisions: the decision records of the 7 days against the 7 days before. made reads the counter harold.decisions.added and evaluated
-- reads harold.decisions.evaluated. good_process_pct and good_outcome_pct are the shares of the evaluated ones with the grade good.
-- due reads the newest export of the gauge harold.decisions.open with status = due, summed over the organisations.
-- Counter rule: the README rule "The counter rule" in docs/references/telemetry/README.md. Each point rises by its value minus the
-- previous point of its series. A first point, or a point below the previous one (Harold restarted), rises by its whole value.
-- The query reads the points of 21 days: 14 days of two weeks and 7 days before them for the previous point.
-- No row while neither counter has a point in the 14 days: the tile shows HyperDX's empty state, not 0.
-- made_change_pct, evaluated_change_pct and due_change_pct are the percent change against the 7 days before. They are empty when that number was 0.
-- good_process_change_pts and good_outcome_change_pts are the change of the share in percentage points. They are empty when a week had no evaluated record.
-- Columns: made, made_change_pct, evaluated, evaluated_change_pct, good_process_pct, good_process_change_pts, good_outcome_pct, good_outcome_change_pts, due, due_change_pct.
SELECT
    made,
    round((made - made_last) / nullIf(made_last, 0) * 100) AS made_change_pct,
    evaluated,
    round((evaluated - evaluated_last) / nullIf(evaluated_last, 0) * 100) AS evaluated_change_pct,
    round(good_process / nullIf(evaluated, 0) * 100) AS good_process_pct,
    round((good_process / nullIf(evaluated, 0) - good_process_last / nullIf(evaluated_last, 0)) * 100, 1) AS good_process_change_pts,
    round(good_outcome / nullIf(evaluated, 0) * 100) AS good_outcome_pct,
    round((good_outcome / nullIf(evaluated, 0) - good_outcome_last / nullIf(evaluated_last, 0)) * 100, 1) AS good_outcome_change_pts,
    due,
    round((due - due_last) / nullIf(due_last, 0) * 100) AS due_change_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.decisions.added' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS made,
        sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.decisions.added' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS made_last,
        sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.decisions.evaluated' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS evaluated,
        sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.decisions.evaluated' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS evaluated_last,
        sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.decisions.evaluated' AND Attributes['process_grade'] = 'good' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS good_process,
        sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.decisions.evaluated' AND Attributes['process_grade'] = 'good' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS good_process_last,
        sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.decisions.evaluated' AND Attributes['outcome_grade'] = 'good' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS good_outcome,
        sumIf(rise, MetricName = 'harold.decisions.evaluated' AND Attributes['outcome_grade'] = 'good' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND TimeUnix <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS good_outcome_last,
        count() AS points
    FROM (
        SELECT
            MetricName,
            Attributes,
            TimeUnix,
            if(Value >= before, Value - before, Value) AS rise
        FROM (
            SELECT
                MetricName,
                Attributes,
                TimeUnix,
                Value,
                lagInFrame(Value, 1, toFloat64(0)) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cityHash64(MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes)
                    ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS before
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
            WHERE MetricName IN ('harold.decisions.added', 'harold.decisions.evaluated')
              AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 21 DAY
        )
    )
) AS counts
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT
        sumIf(v, wk = 'this') AS due,
        sumIf(v, wk = 'last') AS due_last
    FROM (
        SELECT
            if(TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY, 'this', 'last') AS wk,
            Attributes['organisation'] AS organisation,
            argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
        FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
        WHERE MetricName = 'harold.decisions.open'
          AND Attributes['status'] = 'due'
          AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY
        GROUP BY wk, organisation
    )
) AS gauges
WHERE points > 0
LIMIT 1
)
WHERE made IS NOT NULL
